steps.title: Cut off and mate
steps.body: With a rook, push the enemy king to an edge, then bring your king opposite theirs and give check along the edge.

wrong.default: Their king is on the edge and yours is opposite it. Look for the final check.

steps.onSuccess: Rh8 is checkmate: the king on b6 takes away the escape squares.

cards.prompt: Where does the rook mate happen?
solution: On the edge, with your king opposite theirs.
cards.why: The king covers the escape squares.
